newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish bonds rally on EU report, markka firmer.
newsitem.headline: Finnish bonds rally on EU report, markka firmer.

text.p: Bonds rallied on Wednesday taking a cue from stronger Bunds and with help from a boost in sentiment over an EU commission forecast suggesting Finland would meet the EMU criteria for debt and deficit in 1997 and 1998, dealers said.
"This helped our bonds," one dealer said of the commission's report, adding "other peripheral areas have suffered."
The 2006 bond yield spread over Germany narrowed by four basis points to 44, and after such a tightening move some dealers said it was hard to see any further narrowing soon.
Trade was only moderate and focused on the long-end.
